4	
5	Entity-level construction selects $\hat{y}_{\textup{MBR}} = \{e \in E_\cup : \hat{p}(e) > \alpha/(\alpha{+}1)\}$ under balanced set-overlap utility; $\alpha{=}1$ recovers majority vote (Proposition~\ref{prop:construction_mbr}; Table~\ref{tab:entity_construction}; Appendix~\ref{app:mbr_proof}).
6	Signal-derived weights $w_i$ yield quality-weighted MBR: $\hat{p}_w(e) = \sum_{i} w_i \, \mathbf{1}[e {\in} y_i] / \sum_{i} w_i$; weighting improves when $w_i$ correlates with instance quality but degrades otherwise (LP on SciERC: $\rho{\approx}0.2$; \S\ref{sec:prescriptive}).
7	We select $\varepsilon{=}0.05$ at the elbow of the compression curve, where LP-best selection advantage transitions from $+1.5$\,pp (compressed) to $+4.6$\,pp (non-compressed; Appendix~\ref{app:fewnerd_epsilon}).

\subsection{Entity Selection Bound: Proof and Validation}\label{app:alpha_crit}

\begin{proposition}[Entity Selection Diagnostic]\label{prop:entity_selection_bound}
Let $\mathcal{M}^+ {=} \hat{y}_{\textup{MV}} \setminus \hat{y}_{\textup{gr}}$ be entities added by majority vote (precision $\pi_{\mathcal{M}^+}$) and $\delta$ the instance degeneracy rate.
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\alph*)},nosep,leftmargin=*]
\item On degenerate instances, $\hat{y}_{\textup{MV}} {=} \hat{y}_{\textup{gr}}$ and $\Delta F_1 {=} 0$.
\item $\mathbb{E}[\Delta F_1] = (1{-}\delta) \cdot \mathbb{E}[\Delta F_1 \mid \textup{non-deg.}]$.
\item $\Delta F_1 > 0$ only if $\pi_{\mathcal{M}^+} > \alpha_{\textup{crit}} \triangleq F_1^{\textup{gr}}/2$.
\end{enumerate}
\end{proposition}

\begin{proof}[Proof of Proposition~\ref{prop:entity_selection_bound}]
\textbf{Part (a).} On a degenerate instance, all $N$ samples produce the same entity set: $\textup{entities}(y_1) = \cdots = \textup{entities}(y_N)$. For every entity $e \in E_\cup$, the agreement count satisfies $k(e) = N$ (if $e$ appears) or $k(e) = 0$ (if not). Hence $k(e)/N \in \{0,1\}$, and the majority-vote threshold $k(e)/N \geq 1/2$ selects exactly the entities present in any single sample---identical to the greedy output. Thus $\hat{y}_{\textup{MV}} = \hat{y}_{\textup{gr}}$ and $\Delta F_1 = 0$.

"""Generate fig_bound: SC gain vs degeneracy bound (2-panel, single-column)."""
import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

OUT_DIR = Path(__file__).parent

with open(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "artifacts" / "p_impossibility" / "bound_verification.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

configs = data["per_config"]

# --- Parameters from paper ---
ALPHA = 0.068
G_ND_REF = 14.8
EPSILON = 0.3
THETA_CRIT = 0.70

# --- Dataset styling (colorblind-friendly Tol bright + distinct markers) ---
STYLE = {
    "FewNERD": {"color": "#4477AA", "marker": "o", "label": "FewNERD"},
    "SciERC":  {"color": "#EE6677", "marker": "^", "label": "SciERC"},
    "CoNLL":   {"color": "#228833", "marker": "s", "label": "CoNLL"},
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.size": 7,
    "axes.labelsize": 8,
    "axes.titlesize": 8,
    "xtick.labelsize": 6.5,
    "ytick.labelsize": 6.5,
    "legend.fontsize": 5.5,
    "font.family": "serif",
    "mathtext.fontset": "cm",
    "axes.linewidth": 0.5,
    "xtick.major.width": 0.4,
    "ytick.major.width": 0.4,
    "xtick.major.size": 2,
    "ytick.major.size": 2,
    "lines.linewidth": 0.8,
})

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(3.5, 1.65), gridspec_kw={"wspace": 0.42})

# ===== Left panel: SC gain vs Degeneracy =====
for c in configs:
    s = STYLE[c["dataset"]]
    ax1.scatter(c["D"], c["actual_best_delta_pp"],
                color=s["color"], marker=s["marker"],
                s=18, zorder=5, edgecolors="k", linewidths=0.3)

# Bound curve
D_range = np.linspace(0, 0.85, 200)
bound_curve = (1 - D_range) * G_ND_REF * ALPHA
ax1.plot(D_range, bound_curve, color="#CC3333", linewidth=1.0, zorder=4,
         label=fr"Bound ($\alpha$={ALPHA})")

ax1.axvline(x=THETA_CRIT, color="0.4", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.6,
            label=fr"$\theta_{{\mathrm{{crit}}}}$={THETA_CRIT}")
ax1.axhline(y=EPSILON, color="0.4", linestyle=":", linewidth=0.6,
            label=fr"$\varepsilon$={EPSILON} pp")
ax1.axhline(y=0, color="0.3", linewidth=0.3)

# Dataset legend entries
for ds in ["FewNERD", "SciERC", "CoNLL"]:
    s = STYLE[ds]
    ax1.scatter([], [], color=s["color"], marker=s["marker"], s=18,
                edgecolors="k", linewidths=0.3, label=s["label"])

ax1.set_xlabel("Degeneracy rate $D$")
ax1.set_ylabel(r"SC gain $\Delta F_1$ (pp)")
ax1.set_xlim(-0.02, 0.82)
ax1.set_ylim(-1.0, 2.0)
ax1.legend(loc="upper right", framealpha=0.9, edgecolor="0.8",
           handletextpad=0.3, borderpad=0.3, labelspacing=0.25)

# ===== Right panel: Ratio to weak bound (positive-gain only) =====
positive = [c for c in configs if c["actual_best_delta_pp"] > 0]
for c in positive:
    s = STYLE[c["dataset"]]
    ax2.scatter(c["D"], c["bound_ratio"],
                color=s["color"], marker=s["marker"],
                s=18, zorder=5, edgecolors="k", linewidths=0.3)

ax2.axhline(y=0.13, color="0.4", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.6,
            label="0.13")
ax2.axhline(y=0, color="0.3", linewidth=0.3)

ax2.set_xlabel("Degeneracy rate $D$")
ax2.set_ylabel("Ratio (actual / weak bound)")
ax2.set_xlim(-0.02, 0.82)
ax2.set_ylim(-0.01, 0.18)

ax2.legend(loc="upper right", framealpha=0.9, edgecolor="0.8",
           handletextpad=0.3, borderpad=0.3)

for ax in (ax1, ax2):
    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)

fig.savefig(OUT_DIR / "fig_bound.pdf", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.02)
fig.savefig(OUT_DIR / "fig_bound.png", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.02, dpi=300)
print("Saved fig_bound.pdf and fig_bound.png")
